reset.note: Stacks reset to 0 when the big-crit count reaches reset_after_big_crits. That threshold is rank-scaled and supplied by the granting perk (see data/perks/secondary_enervate.json).

verification.notes: Flat crit chance is additive/absolute: Lato (10% base) with 7 stacks = 10% + 7x10% = 80% (source: wiki). Still to confirm in-game: whether a hit's own stack survives when that same hit triggers the reset, and whether the 30/s cap is a min-interval or rolling window.
